summary: E2E testing of ColdChain Dashboard (backend + frontend). 24/24 pytest cases passed covering auth (must-change-password, TOTP enroll, verify 2FA), /api/temperatura ingest (pending registration, wrong password 401, approved flow with alerts: critical <2/>8, warning at 2.5/7.5, none at 5), admin device/alert/stats endpoints, and full transporter flow (auto-assignment, admin endpoint forbidden, wrong hw password). Frontend Playwright: admin split-screen login, ES/EN toggle, change password, 2FA enrollment with visible QR + secret, admin dashboard with KPIs, pending-devices card, devices/alerts/transporters tabs, transporter hw-password unlock and device view with chart all work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login: always returns temp_token with purpose='must_change_password' on first login even for transporter (transporter has must_change_password=False by default, so fine today). If ever a transporter is created with must_change_password=True, the change-password endpoint auto-issues access_token, which is correct.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login - spec mentioned lockout after 5 fails but not implemented. Consider adding.

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True - browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard. Frontend uses localStorage fallback so it works, but httpOnly cookie auth is effectively disabled cross-origin. Recommend echoing request origin.
Cookies are set secure=True, samesite='none' - fine for HTTPS preview but wont work on plain http local dev.
/api/temperatura is fully public: a first-time POST registers arbitrary deviceId/password. Consider rate-limit / allowlist to avoid DB pollution by unauthenticated actors.
_device_status called in a loop on /devices and /stats/summary (O(n) datetime math, fine for small n). Acceptable.
